messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. [valid 2025-07-09 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The security audit flagged long-lived authentication gateway tokens. [valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]
- Authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour as of 2026-01-27. [decision; valid 2026-01-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-01-27]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- Cinder observed at standup on 2026-04-17 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-17]
- Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-10]
- Billing-api has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- The authentication gateway is not Team Ember's service. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
